items.exampleEn: I wash two loads of clothes every week.
Please put the books in a pile on the desk.
items.exampleZh: 請把書在桌上疊成一疊。

items.exampleEn: The tallest man in our town is two meters tall.
items.exampleZh: 我們鎮上最高的人有兩公尺高。

items.exampleEn: Prices have greatly increased this year.
My little brother grew two inches this year.
items.exampleZh: 我弟弟今年長高了兩英吋。

items.exampleEn: You can bring one bag max.
My cat weighs about four kilos.

items.sentenceEn: There is a pile of dirty clothes on the floor.

items.audioEn: I bought a kilo of apples for only fifty dollars.
items.audioZh: 我只花五十元就買到一公斤蘋果。

items.sentenceEn: The town changed greatly after the new station opened.
items.sentenceZh: 新車站啟用後，這個小鎮改變了很多。

items.sentenceEn: This elevator can take eight people max.
items.sentenceZh: 這部電梯頂多能載八個人。

items.stemEn: The truck is carrying a heavy ____ of wood.
items.stemZh: 那輛卡車正載著一大車沉重的木頭。

items.stemEn: He played ____ and lost the game.

items.passageEn: Last weekend, we helped my uncle move to a new apartment. The elevator could take six people max, and it was too small for big boxes, so we carried load after load of boxes up the stairs. In the kitchen, there was a pile of plates. My uncle's new sofa was two meters long, and it was a few inches too wide for the door! In the end, my back hurt badly, but my uncle said our help made the day much easier.
items.passageZh: 上週末，我們幫叔叔搬到新公寓。電梯頂多能載六個人，也放不下大箱子，所以我們一趟又一趟地把箱子搬上樓梯。廚房裡有一疊盤子。叔叔的新沙發有兩公尺長，比門寬了幾英吋！最後，我的背痛得很厲害，不過叔叔說有我們幫忙，這一天輕鬆了很多。

referenceEn: I bought a kilo of bananas.
I bought one kilo of bananas.
rubricZh: 可寫例如 a kilo of…

items.instructionZh: 用 meter 造一個句子，說說某樣東西的長度、高度或距離。
referenceEn: My bed is two meters long.
The bus stop is about a hundred meters from my home.
rubricZh: meter 是可數名詞（例如 two meters）
可寫例如 two meters long、a hundred meters from…

resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 改為 "Last weekend, we helped my uncle move to a new apartment. The elevator could take six people max, and it was too small for big boxes, so we carried load after load of boxes up the stairs. In the kitchen, there was a pile of plates. My uncle's new sofa was two meters long, and it was a few inches too wide for the door! In the end, my back hurt badly, but my uncle said our help made the day much easier."（原 "Last weekend, we helped my uncle move to a new apartment. The elevator could take six people max, so we carried load after load of boxes up the stairs. In the kitchen, there was a pile of plates.
